newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE FEB 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE FEB 21.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Left-wing parties reluctant to engage their full forces in the mobilisation against a bill tightening controls on immigration.

-- Leisure group Club Mediterranee chairman Serge Trigano may be replaced by Euro Disney chairman Philippe Bourguignon at a Club Med board meeting today. Club Med may post 1996 losses of more than 700 million francs.
